resources.name: OpenGatewayExportJob
resources.description: Base entity schema for use in TM Forum Open APIs. Property.

fields.name: completionDate
fields.description: Date on which the job was completed. This attribute exists only when status is Succeeded.

fields.name: contentType
fields.description: The format of the export file. In Open Gateway context it is always application/gzip

fields.name: creationDate
fields.description: Date on which the job was created.

fields.name: path
fields.description: JSON Pointer relative to the API root node that points to the resource acting as the source for streaming content to the export destination specified by the ExportJob. Set to /productUsage in Open Gateway context for this API.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Used to scope the exported data. Identical to GET filter construct using the API node defined by path as base. In Open Gateway context, contains the query parameters used to filter ProductUsage records for export, in particular start and end completionDate.

fields.name: url
fields.description: URL of the file containing exported data.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: JWS (JSON Web Signature) signature of the exported zip file. Used to verify the authenticity and integrity of the exported data.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status of the export job. In this context can only be Succeeded. There is no requirement to share non Succeeded ExportJob.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated properties to be provided in response

params.name: offset
params.description: Requested index for start of resources to be provided in response

params.name: limit
params.description: Requested number of resources to be provided in response

params.name: before
params.description: An opaque string value representing the page results before the cursor value

params.name: after
params.description: An opaque string value representing the page results after the cursor value

params.name: sort
params.description: The default direction is Ascending order, the use of the modifier in front of the sort field name, “-“, changes the sort order direction.

retrieve.description: This operation retrieves a exportJob entity. Attribute selection enabled for all first level attributes.
